contracts: (Compiled hint has exactly scripts/sc/tests/test_evaluation_seed_manifest.py in all three required arrays, with no existing-test or execution-evidence claim.) AND (The S10 selector proves that every detached negative Probe executes independently with its bound inputs and outputs; metadata or surrogate inference is rejected.) AND (The S16 test proves the independent Validator Capability binding is required and rejects its absence.) AND (The S16 test proves the independent output-verification binding is required and rejects its absence.) AND (The authorization-decision check demonstrates that historical evidence cannot authorize an action.) AND (The emitted hint contains exactly scripts/sc/tests/test_detached_probe_execution.py in each required path field and does not claim that it already exists or executed.)
selector_intents: Execute a detached negative Probe through the S10 behavior selector and observe failure when independent process execution or bound input/output evidence is absent.
Exercise an authorization decision whose only purported authority is historical evidence and require the Toolchain check to reject it.
Inspect the compiled seed-manifest execution hint and fail if any required path array omits, changes, or misclassifies scripts/sc/tests/test_evaluation_seed_manifest.py as existing evidence.
Remove the independent Validator Capability binding from a successful Replay Result in the S16 replay test.
Remove the independent output-verification binding from a successful Replay Result in the S16 replay test.
Structurally reject a compiled hint whose required planned detached-Probe path is omitted, changed, or presented as existing evidence.
